flora: Giant Horsetails (towering, bamboo-like ribbed stalks with prominent, ring-like joints)
Terminal spore cones (honeycomb patterns at stalk tips)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; stalks should look thick, organic, and slightly fleshy rather than perfectly straight industrial pipes; emphasize the bold, repeating dark rings at the nodes; soft-touch volume.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle, sweeping look through a dense stand of giant reed-like horsetails growing along a dark lake edge. The ribbing on the trunks creates strong vertical lines reaching toward a hazy, ash-tinted sky.
visual_logic.ground: Damp, charcoal-tinted volcanic ash earth scattered with broken, hollow green stem segments and smooth slate pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; sun rays breaking through volcanic haze, casting dramatic, elongated bar-shadows across the dark ground.
